lessons: Confirmed-correct-do-not-relitigate (2026, verified against official btl.gov.il rate pages): child allowance first/fifth-plus at the base rate and second-to-fourth at the higher rate; child-savings monthly deposit with optional parent match and the age-21 bonus; daycare-subsidy minimum-income thresholds for couples and single parents; credit-point monthly value (frozen through 2027); maternity/birth grant still varying by birth order. A web search may surface an erroneous higher child-allowance figure (a stray snippet quoted inflated per-child amounts); the official BTL rate page is authoritative and matches the skill, do not 'correct' the skill to the stray snippet.

Fixed this cycle: disabled-child allowance low band updated to the current year and reframed (base levels span a wide range up to the highest severity level; the ventilator-dependent figure is a supplement ON TOP of the base, not a standalone total). The prior text understated the top of the range and mislabeled the ventilator figure.
Fixed this cycle: the special-education committee English transliteration was corrected to reflect 'characterization' (ipyun/אפיון), not 'review' (iyun). The Hebrew name was already correct.

Lesson: when correcting a benefit amount, grep every file for the BENEFIT (not just the old number). The disabled-child allowance appeared in the special-education reference file under a DIFFERENT, looser range that a value-grep on the old number missed; the panel caught the leftover contradiction. Search by topic, not only by the figure you are replacing.

Grounding note: the special-ed support-hour bands are illustrative (the committee sets the basket per child) and are now labeled as such; the objection-window day-count was reworded to point at the decision notice rather than assert an unverified number. If a future cycle can source the exact statutory objection window and per-severity hour entitlements, back them and restore the specifics.

CARRY (highest priority next cycle): the תשפ"ז (Sept 2026 - Aug 2027) ma'on and mishpachton tuition tables were NOT published as of 2026-08-19, despite the Ministry page carrying an update stamp of 03.08.2026. references/maon-yom-tuition-tables.md and Step 2 both state this explicitly so the תשפ"ו figures cannot silently read as current. Re-check the Ministry page first thing next cycle and replace all six tables when תשפ"ז lands.

Fixed this cycle (the headline defect): the skill stated ma'on eligibility precisely and then said only that the subsidy 'depends on income tier and family size'. All six published תשפ"ו tables (four מעון variants by operator type and staffing standard, mishpachtonim, extra hour) are now encoded in full in references/maon-yom-tuition-tables.md, with the income bands and grade-setting rules.

Encoding rule that must not be lost: there are FOUR מעון tables, selected by the specific ma'on's operator type (מלכ"ר / שאינו מלכ"ר) and staffing standard (תקינה בסיסית / מורחבת). Step 2 instructs the agent to ASK. Collapsing them into one reproduces the defect being fixed, and misstates the bill by hundreds of shekels a month.

Fixed this cycle, unreported: the income-tax credit-point table was wrong in every band. It said mother 1.5 at age 0, 2.5 for ages 1-5, 1 point for 6-12 'in some cases', and father 1 point to age 5. The Tax Authority guide gives 2.5 / 4.5 / 3.5 / 2.5, then 2.0 (mother) and 1.0 (father) from age 6 to the year before 18, and 0.5 for the mother in the year of 18. Points run to 18, not 12, and the bands key to the TAX YEAR in which the child reaches an age.

Fixed this cycle, unreported: two cost ranges were fabricated behind sources that curl could not reach, so the gate had recorded them as merely 'unreachable' for cycles. The kolzchut psychodidactic-assessment page carries NO shekel figures (the 2,500-4,500 NIS range was invented) and the kolzchut parent-payments portal carries NO shekel figures (the 300-700 / 500-1,200 / 6,000-12,000 ranges were invented). Both were removed from SKILL.md, SKILL_HE.md and two reference files rather than re-sourced, and replaced with what the pages actually support. LESSON: an 'unreachable' evidence entry is a hiding place. Browser-check unreachable entries even when this cycle did not touch them.

Fixed this cycle: the disabled-child allowance was given only as a range (50%-235%, 1,943 to 9,126). The five discrete levels are now enumerated, together with the 235%-plus-ventilator trap (the supplement is paid but the base drops to 188%), the two-caregiver supplement and its two exclusions, the multi-disabled-child 50% uplift, and the institutional rates.

Fixed this cycle: ma'on registration is a roughly one-month national window (15.02.2026-14.03.2026 for תשפ"ז) and is not first-come-first-served. The skill previously said only 'apply via the online service', which would send a parent asking in August to a closed form.

Fixed this cycle: added the 113 NIS child-allowance supplement for the third and fourth child paid to a parent on havtachat hachnasa, mezonot, or an old-age or survivors' pension with income supplement. Unreported, and it lands on the lowest-income families.

Created this cycle: references/domain-checklist.md, which did not exist. It now declares the ma'on grid, the school-year boundary, and every deliberate omission with a rationale, so the next cycle can catch what this one missed.

Checker: the child-allowance manifest was left unregenerated by design. Its formula depends only on the 173 / 219 / 58 figures, all three of which were re-verified against btl.gov.il this cycle and are unchanged, so its four golden cases still hold. No prose amount it depends on was touched.

Deferred over the Phase 4.1 discretionary cap: the Ministry of Education publishes an annual maximum-price list for parent payments. Linking that specific list (rather than the kolzchut portal that merely mentions it) would let the skill give a real ceiling per service. Find the list URL next cycle.

Carried from v1.2.1, re-litigated 2026-08-19 and still out of scope: per-municipality gan fees and tza'haron prices (no national table exists; ~250 authorities set them annually), exact per-severity special-education support-hour entitlements (the committee sets the basket per child), and the statutory objection window in days (not sourced to an authoritative text in two cycles; the skill points at the decision notice, which carries the operative deadline).
